# rustinion Provider

Manages Rustinion (https://rustinion.com) configuration as code through its customer API: groups and their update, restart, alerting and scan policies, alert rules, log alerts and pipelines, notification channels and routes, escalation policies, on-call schedules, dashboards, SLOs, silences, maintenance windows, synthetic checks, SNMP targets, device tags, integrations, RUM applications, scheduled reports, status pages, users and roles. Authenticate with a read+write API key from the organization's admin panel.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) A read-write-scoped Rustinion API key (Tenant admin panel -> API keys -> Read + write). Defaults to the RUSTINION_API_KEY environment variable. Every resource this provider manages is a write, so a read-only key is rejected by the API with a 403 on the first apply.
- `base_url` (String) Base URL of the Rustinion instance to manage, e.g. https://rustinion.com. Defaults to the RUSTINION_BASE_URL environment variable.
